At Powell’s Way of Kenpo, our adult program is designed for real people with real goals. Whether you’re looking to get in shape, learn self-defense, reduce stress, or challenge yourself, our training gives you a clear path to progress. Our adult martial arts classes meet three times each week for 90 minutes. We encourage students to attend as many classes as possible. Tuition for adult Kenpo karate classes is $150 per month.
